chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Abdillah ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me, from his grandfather Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Abu Ayyub Sulayman ibn Muqbil al-Madani, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Sa'd ibn Abi Khalaf al-Zamm, from Abu Ubayda. He said:

Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Whoever says in the marketplace: 'I bear witness that there is no god but God, alone, without partner; and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger,' God records one million good deeds for him.

key_terms.أشهد: 'I bear witness' — the opening formula of the shahada, a formal act of testimony and affirmation
key_terms.ألف ألف حسنة: Literally 'a thousand thousand good deeds' = one million — an expression of immense divine reward
key_terms.السوق: The marketplace/bazaar — a place of commerce and distraction, spiritually significant here as an unlikely context for dhikr
key_terms.لا إله إلا الله: The declaration of tawhid (divine unity): 'There is no god but God'
key_terms.وحده لا شريك له: 'Alone, without partner' — reinforcement of absolute monotheism

ai.seo_question: What reward does a Muslim receive for reciting the shahada in the marketplace according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) teaches that reciting the double shahada (testimony of divine unity and the prophethood of Muhammad) while in the marketplace earns a person one million good deeds from God. The marketplace context is significant: in early Islamic society, the bazaar was a place of noise, distraction, and worldly preoccupation — the antithesis of worship. Uttering words of sincere remembrance of God in such an environment was seen as especially meritorious, a conscious act of piety in an unlikely setting.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: `Ali b. Ahmad b. `Abdullah b. Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi (rh) narrated to us He said: My father narrated to me from his grandfather Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah from Abi Ayyub Sulayman b. Muqbil al-Madani from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Sa`d b. Abi Khalaf al-Zam from Abi `Ubayda. He said:

Abu `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) said: He who says “I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, one without partners, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His Servant and His Messenger (la ilaha illallah wahdahu la shareekalah, wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluh)” in the market, Allah records one million good deeds for him.
